Wide reverse interior composition, camera behind and above Harper. Small adult Harper at lower-left, her body present but subordinate, facing a huge magnified image of the new planet projected on the curved virtual dome. Tiny sparse cyan route graphic arcs across the dome beside the planet, several widely spaced points, no numbers or words. Optical magnification, not physical arrival. No dense HUD, no new furniture or dashboard.

DEPARTURE SEQUENCE LOCK: Cinematic painted graphic-novel space adventure, fine controlled ink contours, detailed illustrated materials, deep indigo space, cyan practical lights and restrained warm amber edges. She wears the same pod-issued warm-gray long-sleeved survival coverall, gathered cuffs, plain closed collar and fastening, gray belt, loose trousers and graphite utility shoes; tiny unlettered amber arm tab. Reference short-sleeved clothing is superseded. Personal ship is the established transparent spherical technological field, faint cyan geodesic grid, graphite equatorial band, upper/lower circular platforms, amber rim lights, sparse cyan rectangular lamps and one vertical open aft engine ring with cyan inner arc. Cabin is the established open spherical volume with curved graphite rail/platform and sparse floating holographic controls, not a conventional airplane cockpit. The newly discovered remote planet has a broad dark-emerald jungle continent, copper-coloured inland seas and ivory storm systems, visibly distinct from the opening turquoise/peach world. Only include subjects required by the specific shot. One uninterrupted full-frame cinematic16:9 image, quiet bottom strip for later lyrics; no captions, readable words, watermarks, panels or collage.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 Harper's exact identity and long-sleeved survival coverall. Image 2 open sphere cabin geometry/rendering only (short sleeves superseded). Image 3 exact discovered planet geography and lighting: preserve this emerald continent, copper inland seas, ivory storms. SCENE-SPECIFIC CONSTRAINT: This is a wide interior reverse shot, one small Harper lower left from behind, not a portrait. The planet is a huge optical projection on the virtual dome, not a planet physically outside nearby. No extra external spacecraft, no furniture/dashboard, no second Harper. Full-frame 16:9, no black letterbox bars.
qa: Accepted. Single rear-view Harper subordinate lower-left; established coverall/curls, open spherical volume/rail, huge matched emerald/copper/ivory planet and sparse cyan route points. No new furniture/dashboard, text or bars. Optical projection intent is conveyed by grid/route though still cannot independently distinguish physical proximity.
